example.title: Coffee shop in a modern stucco front with a flat canopy
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 2000s single-storey café: a cream stucco front with a deep flat projecting canopy carrying the name in raised letters, full-height glazing with a script logo, a timber bench and potted olive trees on the sidewalk. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
